# Arch Wiki

Linxira OS is built directly on Arch Linux, so the Arch Wiki is the primary upstream documentation for system administration, packages, hardware and desktop configuration.

## Why use the Arch Wiki

- Linxira uses `pacman` and the official Arch repositories
- Linxira follows Arch's rolling-release model and does not support partial upgrades
- Generic Arch, systemd, KDE and hardware instructions usually apply as written upstream

## Recommended reading

- [Arch Wiki home](https://wiki.archlinux.org/)
- [General recommendations](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/General_recommendations)
- [List of applications](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/List_of_applications)
- [Power management](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Power_management)
- [Network configuration](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Network_configuration)

## Caveats

The Arch Wiki describes Arch Linux, not Linxira product behaviour. Keep in mind:

- Linxira-specific Welcome, Shelly defaults, the Calamares install flow and Config Hub behaviour are documented here, in this wiki
- AUR is user-submitted build recipes, not part of the official Arch repositories; Linxira does not enable it by default
- Do not run `apt` instructions meant for Debian, Ubuntu or Mint on Linxira
